descriptionChirho: To bring to completion or finish what has been started; active transitive uses of completing a task, work, or divine purpose (Rom 15:28; 2 Cor 8:6, 8:11; Phil 1:6).
To perform or carry out religious rites, sacrificial duties, or acts of holiness; emphasizes the execution of sacred obligations (2 Cor 7:1; Heb 8:5, 9:6).
Passive or middle: to be brought to completion or to reach fulfillment; used of sufferings being accomplished or of being perfected by fleshly effort (Gal 3:3; 1 Pet 5:9).
